showcase.title: 🌟 Glittering Ideas Showcase
showcase.description: Brilliant innovation projects proposed by employees and successfully implemented in our processes.
showcase.awardTitle: Innovators of the Year Award Program
showcase.awardDescription: At the end of each year, the top 3 employees on the podium are selected as "Innovators of the Year". Winners are offered surprise motivational awards (gift vouchers, extra leave, etc.) that can vary depending on the dynamics of the period and the employee's own preferences.
showcase.noMatchTitle: No Glittering Idea Matching Your Search Found
showcase.noMatchDesc: The lights of the showcase are off because there is no 'Glittering Idea' implemented yet, or no results matched your search.
showcase.guideInnovationDesc1: • Approved Idea: For every approved idea scoring 50+ from the referee +50 Points.
showcase.guideInnovationDesc2: • Glittering Idea: For an idea implemented and showcased +100 Extra Points *(Total 150 Points per idea)*.
showcase.guideJuryDesc: It is the sum of the actual evaluation scores between 0-100 given by Idea Coordinators to the ideas.
showcase.guideRule1: The employee with the highest Total Innovation Score takes the lead.
showcase.guideRule2: If scores are equal, the one with the higher Total Referee Jury Scores takes the lead.
showcase.guideRule3: If jury scores are also equal, the leader is determined by Manager's Choice.
